description.en: New captures of the current dual-style island, seasons and night lights, individual homes, gallery, resident chat and steward appearances. Genuine saved Word results and parent/child delegation records are shown alongside newly played native-popup minigame footage and an actual payout. Offline 1440p/60 fps export, original BGM, separate caption margins and a complete ending. No old video clips or interpolation; film frame rate is not a live performance benchmark. Profiles and work briefs are fictional. Minigames are prototypes and will improve.
